stories.title: IRGC warns it is ready to change Iran's nuclear doctrine if ordered
stories.summary: An IRGC spokesperson said Iran is prepared to revise its nuclear doctrine if directed by the state, as Qatar urged Washington and Tehran not to wait for a perfect moment to strike a peace deal.

stories.title: Strait of Hormuz could reopen under Qatari plan for Iran nuclear inspections
stories.summary: Qatar is seeking to persuade Iran to let UN inspectors visit its bombed nuclear sites, with the US lifting its naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz in return.

stories.title: Iran lifts 2,000 km missile range limit as tanker hits mine in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it has dropped its self-imposed 2,000 km cap on ballistic missile range, while its navy reported an oil tanker struck a mine and caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Libghostty 1.0 ships stable C API for terminal emulation
stories.summary: Mitchell Hashimoto released libghostty 1.0, a portable C library extracted from the Ghostty terminal, now with a stable ABI and already powering JetBrains IDE terminals, KDE experiments and Turborepo.

stories.title: Shedeur Sanders named Browns starter vs. Saints; Watson stays in concussion protocol
stories.summary: Cleveland coach Todd Monken confirmed Shedeur Sanders will start Sunday at New Orleans, with Deshaun Watson listed questionable after remaining in the concussion protocol.

stories.title: Antonelli quickest in tricky FP2 at São Paulo GP
stories.summary: New world champion Kimi Antonelli topped Friday's second practice at Interlagos, edging Lando Norris and Max Verstappen as cooler, overcast conditions shaped the session.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Municipalities around Columbus are weighing how widely to deploy Flock license-plate camera systems amid privacy concerns from residents.

stories.title: Columbus court grants 'divorce' from sugar
stories.summary: Franklin County senior citizens, including members of a senior e-sports team, symbolically divorced sugar at a lighthearted court event Friday.

stories.title: One dead, two injured in west Columbus shooting
stories.summary: Columbus police said one person died and two were hurt in a Friday night shooting in the Briggsdale neighborhood, with victims found in a home's basement.
